name: Fire Plume Forged
summary: At Fire Plume Ridge, you face the heat needed to forge a skeletal key stem. The simmering volcano lies west in Un'Goro Crater, where its lava lake can fuse the stem. Then you carry it to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: Fire for the Key Stem
sections.body: Krinkle Goodsteel says the key stem needs two bars of thorium and fierce heat. You find the thorium, and your gold buys a mold. Dip it in the lava lake atop Fire Plume Ridge. There, the heat fuses thorium and bone together.

sections.title: Back to Arbington
sections.body: Krinkle Goodsteel has done their part. To finish the key, you return to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point in the Western Plaguelands. The lava-forged stem remains unfinished. This work prepares you for an assault.

sections.title: What Lies Ahead
sections.body: Alchemist Arbington calls the key costly, yet unfinished. In Andorhal, Araj the Summoner waits as the foe behind all this work. The lich ranks among the Scourge's most powerful.

faq.q: Where is the key stem forged?
faq.answer: The key stem is forged in the lava lake atop Fire Plume Ridge, a simmering volcano west in Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: What is needed to forge the key stem?
faq.answer: You need the skeleton key mold and two bars of thorium. You find the thorium yourself.

aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Alchemist Arbington receives the unfinished key at Chillwind Point in the Western Plaguelands.
